game.title: Bear Rush
game.tagline: Follow the river. Hunt the high country. Outrun the storm.
game.footer: A wild mountain valley, yours to explore.
menu.title: Main menu
controls.title: Field guide
controls.desktop: WASD / arrows move · Ctrl stalks · Shift sprints · Mouse looks · Space / E pounces · Esc pauses
controls.touch: Touch: move the left stick gently to stalk · drag to look · Hunt and sprint buttons on the right
controls.stalk: Stalk with Ctrl or a light stick input. Watch the wind; sprinting carries farther and spends stamina.
controls.goal: Follow fading tracks, approach upwind and quietly, then keep close through a species-specific chase. Pounce only at the brief exhaustion cue.
controls.hazards: Only poisonous food, bear traps and trench falls drain health. At 0%, you lose a life; falls hit harder at speed.
hud.map.label: Local wildlife tracking map. Fresh sightings fade as animals move.
hud.map.wind: Wind arrow shows where scent travels; approach from the opposite, upwind direction.
hud.map.legend: S salmon · H honey · F fawn · D deer · E elk · M moose · teal arrow = wind flow
hint.move: Ctrl stalks at a quiet pace; a light touch-stick input does the same. Watch the wind before closing in.
hint.hunt: Stay near prey through the chase. Wait for its exhausted posture, close the gap, face it, and time one fast pounce.
hint.dangers: Poison, traps and trench falls chip away at health. A fall hits harder at speed; 0% costs a life.
pause.title: Take a breath
pause.message: The mountain hunt is paused. The weather will keep moving.
